description: A key-value cache layer with TTL, fill leases and invalidation, consumed through a library driver. A provider service emits this configuration group; a consumer opens the named driver with it. Every stack operation is scoped to a caller-supplied partition; drivers store the keys the stack hands them and never see a partition. A driver's optional notifications report every change to a key, by any writer, and a driver that can lose notifications signals each gap so consumers resync.

keys.name: driver
keys.description: The driver a consumer opens, as registered with cache.Register, e.g. "redis".

keys.name: connection
keys.description: The driver-specific connection string. For "redis": a redis:// or rediss:// URL.
